name: financials_list_financial_transaction_class_map
description:
Explains how financial-transaction SERVICES map to SUMMARY CLASSES: returns the full classification rulebook from neonpanel_iceberg.financial_transaction_class_map -- one rule per (service_key, sign, fulfillment) -> summary_class / summary_subclass (+ display ordering) -- together with a plain-language 'classification_rules' section describing how the engine resolves rules.

Resolution model: a line's service_key is matched with its sign (POS = amount >= 0, NEG = amount < 0); the summary CLASS is usually constant per service while the SUBCLASS flips with sign (charge vs refund); a fulfillment-specific rule (AFN/MFN) beats the '*' wildcard (e.g. Commission NEG -> 'FBA selling fees' on AFN vs 'Seller fulfilled selling fees' on MFN); unmatched lines report as 'Unclassified' / 'Unmapped: <key>' so money is never dropped.

This taxonomy reproduces Amazon Seller Central 'Monthly Unified Summary' statement lines (reconciled line-by-line against a real Jun-2026 statement). class_order: 1=Income, 2=Expenses, 3=Tax, 4=Transfers.

Use financials_list_financial_transaction_services to see which services actually occur in a specific company's data; use financials_analyze_financial_transactions for the money.

Knowledge base: https://help.neonpanel.com

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on service_key or summary_subclass.

summary_classes.description: Optional filter: only rules for these summary classes (Income, Expenses, Tax, Transfers).
